newsitem.title: UK: Gulf Canada says Clyde bid unconditional.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada says Clyde bid unconditional.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd on Wednesday declared its 494 million stg offer for Clyde Petroleum wholly unconditional.

It added that the offer will remain open for further acceptances after Gulf Canada yesterday announced it held 51.42 percent of its bid target, which had argued that the 120 pence per share bid was too low.

"We are, of course, most pleased with the outcome, but remain respectful of the efforts by Clyde's management to do what they considered best for their shareholders," said Gulf Canada's president and chief executive officer, J.P. Bryan.
"We look forward to working with the management and employees of Clyde to grow the business in the North Sea and around the world," he added.
